Formulas Dream Shot Review

17Nov 2026
Add a comment
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 8:05
Instaread

I was curious about the Formulas Dream Shot. When you’re training, sleep is a big part of recovery. I’ve become more conscious of how much sleep I get over the years because, no matter how much I enjoy running, I can’t keep increasing my mileage without giving my body time to recover. I’ve tried different recovery products over the years, and sleep supplements have become a huge category. There are gummies, powders, magnesium drinks, and now peptide shots.

The Formulas Dream Shot caught my attention because of its peptide ingredient, PeptiSleep. The company claims its combination of ingredients can help athletes fall asleep faster, stay asleep longer, and spend more time in restorative sleep.

But what does a peptide sleep supplement do, and how does Formulas Dream Shot compare to other sleep products?

Let’s get into an honest Formulas Dream Shot review. 

Advertisement

Formulas Dream Shot FAQ

Does Formulas Dream Shot contain melatonin?

No. Dream Shot uses rice-derived peptides, magnesium, glycine, L-theanine, ashwagandha, and tart cherry instead of added melatonin.

When should you take Formulas Dream Shot?

The company recommends taking it 30 to 60 minutes before bed.

Does Formulas Dream Shot help with running recovery?

It is marketed for sleep and athletic recovery, but there is limited independent research demonstrating recovery benefits from the complete formula.

Is Formulas Dream Shot expensive?

At $29.99 for six servings, each serving costs about $5.

What Is Formulas Dream Shot?

Formulas Dream Shot is a two-ounce liquid sleep supplement designed for athletes. It combines magnesium, amino acids, ashwagandha, tart cherry, and rice-derived peptides. Unlike many sleep supplements, Dream Shot doesn’t contain added melatonin. The formula focuses on ingredients associated with relaxation and sleep regulation.

There are two versions: Original Tart Cherry Juice and No Sugar. The original has 75 calories and 16 grams of sugar per serving. Both versions have the same core supplement ingredients.

The recommended serving is one shot approximately 30 to 60 minutes before bed.

At The Feed, a six-pack costs $29.99, or about $5 per serving. That’s $150 for 30 nights before taxes or discounts, which is a expensive.

Advertisement

Formulas Dream Shot Ingredients

There are six main ingredients in Dream Shot:

PeptiSleep (250 mg): PeptiSleep is derived from rice protein. The manufacturer claims it can reduce nighttime cortisol activity and increase deep sleep. The ingredient is relatively new, and published independent human research remains limited.

Magnesium L-Threonate (1,000 mg): This provides 72 mg of elemental magnesium. Magnesium is involved in muscle and nerve function, although research into magnesium supplements for sleep has produced mixed results. Magnesium L-threonate is marketed for its potential effects on the brain.

Glycine (3,000 mg): Glycine is an amino acid involved in body temperature regulation. Small human studies have found improvements in subjective sleep quality with three grams before bed. Dream Shot uses that same dose.

L-Theanine (200 mg): Found in tea, L-theanine has been studied for relaxation and stress. The dose in Dream Shot falls within the range used in human sleep research.

Ashwagandha (100 mg): Ashwagandha has been studied for stress and sleep, although research results depend on the extract and dose. People taking certain medications or managing thyroid conditions should check with a healthcare professional before using it.

Tart Cherry: Tart cherry has become popular in running recovery products. It contains compounds associated with antioxidant activity and has been studied for sleep duration and muscle recovery.

I’ve also reviewed Cheribundi Tart Cherry Gummies, another product aimed at runners interested in tart cherry supplementation.

How Does Formulas Dream Shot Work?

Advertisement

Dream Shot attempts to address several parts of sleep through one formula.

Glycine has been studied for its effects on body temperature and perceived sleep quality. L-theanine and ashwagandha target stress-related pathways, while magnesium supports normal nervous system function.

PeptiSleep is the ingredient that separates Dream Shot from many competing products. Formulas promotes the rice-derived peptides as a way to influence nighttime cortisol and sleep stages.

The research question is whether combining these ingredients produces better results than taking one of them alone. The current evidence doesn’t establish that Dream Shot can increase deep sleep or improve athletic recovery across a broad population.

Formulas Dream Shot for Runners

I am fascinated by how running recovery products have changed. A decade ago, most recovery conversations centered on protein drinks, foam rollers, and ice baths. Now athletes can purchase products marketed toward specific sleep stages.

During marathon training, poor sleep can affect how I feel during workouts and how much training I can handle. I also know from experience that increasing mileage without enough recovery can have consequences. Dream Shot is marketed toward athletes who want sleep support without melatonin. The small serving is convenient after an evening workout or when traveling for a race.

I wouldn’t use a supplement as an excuse to ignore other recovery habits. If you’re sleeping five hours and trying to run high mileage, drinking a peptide shot doesn’t give me the other three hours you need. None of these products are miracle workers and you still have to do the “small stuff”.

For comparison, I’ve reviewed Momentous Elite Sleep, Vital Performance Sleep, and KA-EX Cortisol Stress Reducer. Each takes a different approach to sleep or recovery.

Advertisement

Formulas Dream Shot Taste and Convenience

The original formula uses concentrated tart cherry juice, while the no-sugar version uses a cherry-based alternative. The serving size is an advantage for people who dislike taking pills or mixing powders before bed. Two ounces also makes it easier to pack for travel.

When I first opened one of the Formulas Dream Shot, I was surprised to see it’s a very thick consistency…and brown. That’s not exactly something I think: wow this looks like what I would like to drink. As far as taste, it’s not the worst product I’ve tried but I don’t think: wow I would like to drink this. Like Bicarb, no pain, no gain. And by that I mean, you’re probably going to have to consume something that isn’t “tasty”.

Is Formulas Dream Shot WADA Approved and Safe for Drug-Tested Athletes?

Advertisement

If you’re a competitive runner, checking whether a supplement contains banned substances should be part of your research before purchasing it. Formulas Dream Shot contains PeptiSleep, a rice-derived peptide, which may raise questions for athletes subject to drug testing.

First, the World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) does not approve or certify dietary supplements. Instead, WADA maintains a list of prohibited substances that athletes must follow. The good news is that both the original Formulas Dream Shot and Dream Shot No Sugar appear in the official NSF Certified for Sport database.

Cost:

Whew, cost is the Formulas Dream Shot downfall. At nearly $5 a shot, this is one of the more expensive products and basically costs a new pair of running shoes a month. That is a lot of money and probably the reason most athletes cannot invest in using it consistently. Do I think the Formulas Dream Shot is worth the cost? Good sleep is premium, it just depends on how much money you are willing to throw at it.

Advertisement

Formulas Dream Shot Review Conclusion

Formulas Dream Shot has a transparent ingredient label, convenient packaging, and a combination of ingredients with varying degrees of sleep research behind them. At $5 per shot, I’d want to see a clear improvement in my sleep before making it part of my regular recovery routine.

Who Should Buy Formulas Dream Shot?

  • Athletes interested in a melatonin-free supplement
  • Runners who prefer a drink over capsules
  • People who want a premeasured combination of sleep-support ingredients

Who Should Skip Formulas Dream Shot?

  • Cost
  • People taking medications that interact with its ingredients
  • Anyone with ongoing insomnia who needs a medical evaluation
